description: This file defines an interface IStream and a template class StreamType that extends a base stream class with additional functionality, within the WPEFramework::Core namespace.

classes.name: IStream
classes.description: An interface for stream operations including open, close, trigger, and status checks.

classes.name: StreamType
classes.description: A template class that inherits from a base stream class and implements the IStream interface, adding standardized methods for stream control.

methods.name: StreamType
methods.description: Constructor template that forwards arguments to the base stream class.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the stream is open by delegating to the base stream class.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the stream is closed by delegating to the base stream class.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier of the stream by delegating to the base stream class.

methods.name: RemoteId
methods.description: Returns the remote identifier of the stream by delegating to the base stream class.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the stream with a specified wait time by delegating to the base stream class.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream with a specified wait time by delegating to the base stream class.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the stream by delegating to the base stream class.
